paragraphs.text:
The  ape-men  stir.  One  points  with  his  great  palm  outward 
against  the  sky.  Out  there  are  several  black  specks—flying 
things. They steadily grow larger.

You  cannot  believe  your  eyes.  Flying  crustaceanoids,  with 
tentacles  as  their  forward  parts. The  sasquatches  release  you 
and cower and shriek in submission. You turn and flee in terror.
Gain 1 point of Cthulhu Mythos. Go to 510.
